items.title: Sections on the spectrum of a strictly henselian local ring are the stalk at the closed point
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for the spectrum S of a strictly henselian local ring with closed point sbar the global sections functor on abelian sheaves is exact, indeed the global sections of any sheaf of sets are the stalk at sbar, and consequently the higher etale cohomology of every abelian sheaf vanishes (statement lines 8206-8218). The proof identifies the global sections with the stalk at the closed point, using that every etale neighbourhood of the closed point admits a section (proof lines 8220-8232), and then uses exactness of the stalk functor to obtain exactness of global sections and the vanishing (proof lines 8232-8242). The non-formal content is the identification of sections with the stalk. The claim is H2: one identification plus one exactness argument.
